name: The calendar of Aetheris and Kaelmar
about: One 363-day year on both continents: twelve 30-day months in four seasons, three festival days outside the months, and seven-day weeks. Kaelmar counts After Bloom (AB); Aetheris counts Unbound years from the broken Cycle (Unbound = AB − 269). Holy days are from Faith in Practice; the moons from The Moons.

festivals.name: First Light
festivals.what: New Year's Day. Lamps are put out the night before and relit at dawn from a neighbour's. Feuds are supposed to end.

festivals.name: Bloom Eve
festivals.what: The night before, Kaelmar remembers the Shrouding. Families sit up with the doors shut, and open them together at dawn.

festivals.name: First Morning
festivals.what: Nobody sleeps the night before. At dawn, people go outside to check the world is still there.

festivals.name: Seedwake
festivals.what: The first seed is sung into the ground.

festivals.name: The Sundering
festivals.what: The Drowned Saints mourn the sea's god at the docks. Everyone else stays home.

festivals.name: Midsummer and the Red Games
festivals.what: Bonfires everywhere; the great tournament in Varkhaal's Great Arena.

festivals.name: The Long Watch
festivals.what: A night of counting stars. Children learn to steer by them.

festivals.name: Harvest Home
festivals.what: The last sheaf is left in the field.

festivals.name: Naming Day
festivals.what: The year's dead are named and carved on the Name Stones.

festivals.name: Masking Night
festivals.what: Masks in the street, and nothing done behind one counts. A week long in Noctis.

festivals.name: Evernight
festivals.what: The longest night. Every household keeps a light burning till dawn, and nobody travels. In Ashvale, the keeping song is sung at the stones all night.
